verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a broad REST API (contracts, payroll, time-off, people) plus an MCP server mapping many UI operations (listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest, EOR cost calculators) to callable tools, indicating substantial functional parity between UI and API/agent access. However, there is no explicit documentation or independent confirmation of full 1:1 parity across every UI feature (e.g., admin settings, benefits management, invoicing nuances), so full parity cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or exhaustive endpoint-to-UI-feature mapping, and independent verification that no UI action is API-inaccessible.
